name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: HubSpot CRM Architect & Implementation Specialist

As a fractional implementation manager I build directly in client portals, run the client calls, and translate business requirements into working systems, backed by 15+ years of onboarding and account management across MarTech, SaaS, and agency environments.
